evidence: M-O s.v. card suit: spades, from Vives 1540
terms.comment: “Points”, spearheads: classically the point of a dart or arrow (Cic. Fam. 5.12.5), as the French name piques means pikes. Vives also calls them vōmercula seu pālās.
Classically a spade (Cato, Liv.), as in the English name.

sources: Lewis & Short: spiculum · Lewis & Short: pala
